projects.name: Content Reading App
projects.description: Developed a content-sharing and reading platform using ASP.NET Core Web API with Angular frontend. Implemented content creation, reading, updating, deletion, categorization, and search functionality. Designed the application so users can act as both authors and readers, allowing them to manage their own content and explore content published by others. Used Entity Framework Core for database operations and implemented Clean Architecture to maintain separation of concerns and improve maintainability.

projects.name: E-Commerce App
projects.description: Implemented product categories, search, filtering, pagination, shopping cart, and order management. Built CRUD functionality for admin/seller users to add, update, and delete products. Implemented order functionality allowing users to place, view, and search their orders. Used EF Core for efficient database operations and REST APIs for communication between the frontend and backend.

projects.name: AI Chatbot Web App
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered chatbot web application with FastAPI REST APIs and an Angular frontend for interactive and responsive chat and dashboard interfaces and conversation history management, allowing users to create, store, view, and delete chats. Integrated the OpenAI API to enable AI-powered conversations with a responsive, real-time chat experience.

projects.name: Result History Web App
projects.description: Developed a web-based student result portal for quickly accessing examination results. Implemented result searching using Enrollment Number / GR Number and subject-specific access mechanisms. Used for any recently uploaded result data from Excel-based sources for displaying student marks. Designed a responsive and simple interface using HTML, JavaScript, and Bootstrap for easy access on different devices.
